messages:
Diego: Hey team — quick life update: twins arrived this morning 🎂🎂 and also I got promoted to Senior Backend Engineer (!!) 😅🎉. Celebratory cake is mandatory. Planning a tiny housewarming/baby cake next Friday, 4pm. Who's in?
Lina: DIEGO!!! omg congrats to all of you ❤️❤️. Need pics pls.
Jess: Wow huge congrats congrats congrats. Count me in for cake (and baby cuddles if allowed). :heart_eyes:
Omar: Congrats Diego!!! Promotion AND twins in one week? Legend. Will bring coffee + challah.
Priya: Amazing news — congrats 🎉. For cake: chocolate, lemon, or funfetti? Vote with emojis: :one: chocolate, :two: lemon, :three: funfetti.
Asha: :tada::tada: so happy for you. For names — have you picked any?
Diego: Thanks all!! We went with Maia + Mateo for now but still testing them out 😂. No strict rules yet.
Jess: Maia & Mateo are adorable. Vote: cake = :three: (funfetti) from me.
Omar: :one: for chocolate. Also is this a bring-kids event or adults-only?
Diego: Adults welcome, kids welcome, dogs welcome. Small apartment, so cross your fingers on space.
Priya: I'll do a tiny sticker poll in case people want to bring partners. Quick poll: react with :busts_in_silhouette: if bringing +1, :bust_in_silhouette: if solo.
Asha: Adding a request — Diego if you want an extra hand with childcare for the day, I can cover a couple hours.
Diego: Appreciate it, Asha. Might take you up on that during the afternoon — will DM.
people-ops-bot: Congrats message queued to be sent to the company shoutouts channel this afternoon.
Lina: Also we need cake logistics — who can pick up? I can swing by the bakery on my way from HQ.
Jess: If Lina's grabbing, I can grab napkins + forks.
Omar: I'll bring a small bluetooth speaker for background music. Low-volume baby-friendly playlist.
Priya: Final cake vote tally so far: :one: 2 — chocolate (Omar + ?), :two: 0 — lemon, :three: 3 — funfetti (Jess + Priya + Lina). Looks like funfetti is winning.
Diego: Funfetti it is 😆. Thank you everyone — this means a ton. Pics incoming after nap time.
Lina: Can't wait! Sending you and the fam big hugs. :hugs:
Jess: Welcome Maia & Mateo 🥰
Omar: Congrats again. See you Friday 4pm (address DMed).
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Diego cake + twins celebration" Friday 4pm — calendar invite sent to attendees who reacted.
